## Project Status & Dates

**Project Status:** The team iterated on the data migration/cutover plan this period — circulated for review July 17, revised per Rob's feedback July 21–22 — while case file functionality was opened early to unblock UAT scenarios that depend on an existing open case. A new cost signal emerged: Rob flagged that FAMCare's database structure is unusually poor quality and may require a change request and contingency-budget spend to build reliable migration scripts. Client engagement was notably positive this period — Ross and team were cooperative and accommodating despite a busy Treaty Days week, a welcome contrast to the capacity pushback seen last period.

**Variance:** Planned finish 2026-03-31 → Estimated finish 2026-07-31 (+122 days)

## Progress This Period

- Data migration/cutover plan (2-page brief) drafted and circulated to Varun, Gabrielle, and Rob for review (July 17); revised per Rob's feedback and recirculated (July 22).
- Case file functionality opened ahead of schedule so Ross's team can test intake scenarios that depend on an existing open case.
